_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_mechanics#3 — KINEM takes exactly 'linear' or 'nonlinear', and 'nonlinearTotLag' is 4C's own OUTPUT spelling rather than an input. Six arms of one self-contained 3D HEX8 deck, run 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C. Observed: both legal spellings exit 0 with 'processor 0 finished normally'; 'nonlinearTotLag', 'NonLinear' and 'updated_lagrange' each exit 1 with "Could not parse parameter 'KINEM': invalid value '<what you wrote>'. Valid options are: linear|nonlinear", so there is no case-insensitive fallback and no separate updated-Lagrangian spelling. The last arm closes the loop and is the reason the wrong spelling circulates at all: a deck that writes the LEGAL 'KINEM nonlinear' plus one unparseable trailing token makes 4C dump the container it just built, and in that dump the value reads 'KINEM : nonlinearTotLag' (ECHO_SPELLS_TOTLAG=yes while DECK_WROTE_PLAIN_NONLINEAR=yes). So 'nonlinear' already IS the total-Lagrangian formulation and the echoed name must not be copied back into a deck.
expect_in_output: Could not parse parameter 'KINEM': invalid value 'nonlinearTotLag'. Valid options are: linear|nonlinear
Could not parse parameter 'KINEM': invalid value 'NonLinear'
Could not parse parameter 'KINEM': invalid value 'updated_lagrange'
After parsing, the line still contains 'WHATEVER'.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: write the legal spelling in the TOTLAG arm. The enum rejection disappears and EXIT_TOTLAG becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
remove the leftover token from the echo arm. 4C then has nothing to complain about, prints no 'Parsed parameters:' dump, and ECHO_SPELLS_TOTLAG flips to no, so the fixture must go red.
